hunt.name: Akira: Remote Access and Security Software Disruption
hunt.description:
This hunt identifies early-stage Akira ransomware activity by correlating inbound RDP connections with subsequent efforts to blind security tools. It specifically looks for the cessation of Bitdefender services and the execution of rare binaries from the PerfLogs directory, a known staging area for this threat actor.

By examining authentication, service activity, and process telemetry, the hunt builds a timeline of compromise from initial lateral entry to the dumping of LSASS memory. An agent evaluates the combined evidence to distinguish between administrative maintenance and a coordinated ransomware precursor.

config.scoping_notes: Begin the hunt on domain controllers and servers with public-facing services. Use the attacker workstation name 'C1IFRYXI' as a high-fidelity starting point.
config.beyond_detection: A simple alert for Bitdefender stopping is too noisy for most environments. This hunt correlates the RDP source (who), the service disruption (what), and the rare binary execution (why) into a single analytical verdict.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, src_endpoint_hostname, actor_user_name, time FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE (LOWER(src_endpoint_hostname) = LOWER('{{attacker_workstation}}') OR (logon_type_id = 10 AND src_endpoint_hostname != '')) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify hosts targeted by RDP sessions from the reported attacker workstation or other external sources.
config.expected_signal: Hosts receiving RDP connections from the specific workstation name C1IFRYXI or high-volume remote interactive logins.

primitive_config.label: Inbound RDP Scoping
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, src_endpoint_hostname, actor_user_name, time FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE (LOWER(src_endpoint_hostname) = LOWER('{{attacker_workstation}}') OR (logon_type_id = 10 AND src_endpoint_hostname != '')) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: Hosts receiving RDP connections from the specific workstation name C1IFRYXI or high-volume remote interactive logins.

config.content: SELECT LOWER(process_path) AS path, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS hosts, COUNT(*) AS exec_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\\perflogs\\%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\\temp\\%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY LOWER(process_path) HAVING hosts <= 3 ORDER BY hosts ASC
config.description: Find rare executables running from PerfLogs or Temp directories, which are used by Akira for staging tools like ProcDump.
config.expected_signal: A binary like procdump.exe or svchost.exe (masqueraded) running from C:\PerfLogs on a small number of hosts.

primitive_config.label: Rare Processes in PerfLogs
primitive_config.content: SELECT LOWER(process_path) AS path, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS hosts, COUNT(*) AS exec_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\\perflogs\\%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\\temp\\%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY LOWER(process_path) HAVING hosts <= 3 ORDER BY hosts ASC
primitive_config.expected: A binary like procdump.exe or svchost.exe (masqueraded) running from C:\PerfLogs on a small number of hosts.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, service_name, service_state, time FROM hb_service_activity WHERE (LOWER(service_name) LIKE '%bitdefender%') AND (LOWER(service_state) LIKE '%stop%' OR LOWER(service_state) LIKE '%disable%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify security service disablement following RDP access.
config.expected_signal: Multiple Bitdefender services being stopped on a host shortly after an inbound RDP session.
